title: Study of Izalontamab Brengitecan (BMS-986507) in Combination With Osimertinib Versus Osimertinib Monotherapy or Osimertinib in Combination With Platinum-based Chemotherapy for EGFRmt Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (IZABRIGHT-Lung02)
target_population: EGFR-mutant (exon19 del or exon21 L858R), non-squamous, locally advanced/metastatic/recurrent NSCLC patients who have not received prior systemic treatment, ECOG 0-1, with measurable extracranial disease
intervention_summary: Izalontamab brengitecan (iza-bren) combined with osimertinib vs osimertinib monotherapy vs osimertinib combined with platinum-based chemotherapy (pemetrexed + carboplatin/cisplatin) in treatment-naive EGFR-mutant NSCLC
key_conditions: EGFR exon19 deletion or exon21 L858R mutation

rules.text: Participants must have histologically or cytologically confirmed non-squamous NSCLC
newly diagnosed locally advanced (Stage IIIB/IIIC), metastatic (Stage IVA/IVB), or recurrent disease not amenable to curative surgery or definitive radiotherapy and requiring systemic treatment
Participants must have documented EGFR-TKI-sensitizing mutation (exon 19 deletion or exon 21 L858R substitution)
Participants must have measurable extracranial disease per RECIST v1.1 as assessed by the investigator
Participants must have ECOG Performance Status 0-1
Participants must not have unstable, symptomatic, or uncontrolled CNS metastases, including brain, leptomeningeal disease, and/or spinal cord compression
Participants must not have history of ILD/pneumonitis requiring treatment with steroids (≥ Grade 2), or current or suspected ILD/pneumonitis
Participants must not have clinically significant cardiac disease

parsing_notes: I1/I2는 원문의 단일 선정 기준 문장을 조직학적 진단(비편평 NSCLC)과 병기/치료이력 요건(국소진행성/전이성/재발, 근치적 치료 불가, 전신치료 필요)으로 분리함. I3(EGFR 변이)은 특정 변이명이 명시되어 있으나 구조화 필드로 매핑할 표준 바이오마커 필드가 없어 structured_evaluable=false로 둠. ECOG 0-1은 field=ecog, operator<=, value=1로 구조화. CT.gov 구조화 필드(age>=18, sex=ALL)를 본문에 없더라도 규칙으로 추가함. E3 'clinically significant cardiac disease'는 구체적 기준값이 없어 underspecified=true. E4 'Other protocol-defined inclusion/exclusion criteria apply'는 공개되지 않은 추가 기준을 지칭하므로 underspecified=true. 코호트 구분은 없음(단일 집단, arm은 무작위 배정일 뿐 기준 동일).
